info.title: Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform RESTful API

tags.name: Administrator
tags.description: The Administrator module enables administrators to perform administrative operations, such as handling licenses and users.

get.description: This API call output the available collectors installers

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description:
Specifies the organization. The value that you specify for this parameter indicates how the operation applies to an organization(s). Some parts of the Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform system have separate, non shared data that is organization-specific. Other parts of the system have data that is shared by all organizations. The value that you specify for the organization parameter, as described below, determines to which organization(s) an operation applies:
•	Exact organization name – Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly.
•	All organizations – Indicates that the operation applies to all organizations. In this case, the same data is shared by all organizations.

parameters.name: addLicenseBlob

Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly

aggregators.description:
Specifies the list of aggregators. Each aggregator holds the following parameters (supported in V2.7.3 and above):
•	name: Specifies the aggregator device name.
•	address: Specifies the aggregator IP address.
•	version: Specifies the aggregator version.
•	status: Indicates the status of the aggregator: Enabled/Degraded

collectorVersionsV2.description: Specifies the collector versions with counts per version

collectorsDegradedState.description: Specifies the collector’s degraded state: FailedConfigurationUpdate, GatewayUnreachable, PAEDisabled, ContentUpdateError, unsupportedOSVersion, DriverLoadFailure, ApproveKernelExtensions, NoConfiguration, NoDiskSpace, MissingMiniFilterSupport, OTIFailed, LostConnection, MissingPolicyEngine, UsingPreviousPolicyEngineFailedToUpgrade, BSOD, DriverVerifierDetected, OsxNetworkExtensionNotApproved, OsxEndpointSecurityExtensionNotApproved, OsxNeitherExtensionIsApproved, OsxFortiEdrWasNotGrantedFullDiskAccess, OsxEndpointSecurityExtensionWasNotGrantedFullDiskAccess and provides a count for each of them

collectorsDisconnectedState.description: Specifies the collector’s disconnected state: disconnected, expired, migrated, pending migrated and provides a count for each of them

collectorsRunningState.description: Specifies the collector’s running state: autonomously, core and provides a count for each of them

collectorsState.description: Specifies the collector’s state: Running, Disconnected, Disabled, Degraded or RebootPending, and provides a count for each of them

collectorsWithDumps.description: Specifies the collector’s that has crash dumps: NsloCollectorService, NsloCollector, WindowsKernelMini, WindowsKernelFull, LinuxKernelPanic, MacOSKernelPanic, and provides a count for each of them

cores.description:
Specifies the list of cores. Each core holds the following parameters (supported in V2.7.3 and above):
•	name: Specifies the core device name.
•	address: Specifies the core IP address.
•	version: Specifies the core version.
•	status: Indicates the status of the core: Enabled/Degraded.

ecsStatus.description: Specifies the ECS status. Possible values are: Disabled, Enabled, Degraded, Down

environmentUniqueId.description: Specifies the management ID as defined in ECS

iotDevicesInUse.description: Specifies the IoT devices in use

iotDevicesLicenseCapacity.description: Specifies the IoT device’s license capacity

licenseFeatures.description:
Specifies the license features assigned to you, which can include the following:
•	Threat Hunting
•	Forensics
•	Communication Control
•	Protect Anywhere 
•	Vulnerability
•	IoT
•	eXtended Detection

licenseType.description: Specifies the license type. Possible values are (separated by ;): Discover, Protect and Response; Discover, Protect and Response [On-Premise]; Discover and Protect; Protect and Response

maxAccountCount.description: Specifies the max number of organizations limit

repositories.description:
Specifies the list of repositories. Each repository holds the following parameters (supported in V3.5.0 and above):
•	address: Specifies the repository IP address.
•	status: Indicates the status of the repository: Running/Disconnected

repositoryAddOns.description: Specifies the number of repository add-ons

serverCollectorsInUse.description: Specifies the server collectors in use

serverCollectorsLicenseCapacity.description: Specifies the server collector’s license capacity

systemState.description: Indicates the system state: Protection/Simulation (supported in V2.7.3 and above)

workstationCollectorsLicenseCapacity.description: Specifies the workstation collector’s license capacity

workstationsCollectorsInUse.description: Specifies the workstation collectors in use

updateVersions.description: List of installer versions that should be applied in the collector groups.

FCS.description: Specifies FCS status: up | down | degraded | disabled

Repository.description: Specifies repository status: up | down | degraded | disabled
